expectedFacts: Application.initializeRepositories (application.ts, awaited from convert before conversion starts) builds a RepositoryManager and asks it to initialize repositories for every directory that holds a source file of the programs.

CRITICAL: GitRepository.tryCreateRepository, when no link pattern was configured, reads the remote's URL with the git command line and derives the pattern with guessSourceUrlTemplate (recognises GitHub, GitHub-enterprise, Bitbucket and GitLab hosts).
GitRepository.getURL fills the pattern placeholders (revision, short revision, path relative to the repository root, line); the revision is git's HEAD commit (or the branch name when requested).

CRITICAL: GitRepository.getURL returns undefined for any file that is not in the repository's tracked-file list (git ls-files), so untracked or ignored files get no address; files outside every repository, and files in a repository whose remote URL is not a recognised host (tryCreateRepository then creates no repository), also get none.
SourcePlugin.onBeginResolve sets each source reference's url from repositories.getURL(fullFileName, line) and rewrites its shown file name relative to a base path.
member.sources.tsx sourceLink prints plain file:line text when the reference has no url and an anchor otherwise.

CRITICAL: Converter's constructor registers a built-in unknown-symbol resolver: it only handles references that start from the global scope, looks up mappings[ref.moduleSource ?? 'global'], uses the dotted symbol path (plus meaning suffix) as the key and falls back to a '*' entry.

When the resolver receives a symbol id (a type used in a signature, or a comment link that TypeScript itself resolved) it re-enters with symbolId.toDeclarationReference(), whose moduleSource is the symbol's package name, so a type from the TypeScript lib files is looked up under the 'typescript' entry; a comment link written as a global declaration reference (leading '!') has no module source and is looked up under 'global'.

linkResolver.resolveLinkTag asks the external resolvers only after it found no documented target, both for a TypeScript-resolved symbol id with no reflections and for a parsed declaration reference that resolveDeclarationReference cannot resolve; a string (or object with target/caption) result becomes the link part's target.
LinkResolverPlugin.resolveLinks does the same for ReferenceTypes that have no reflection and stores the URL in type.externalUrl.
CRITICAL: validation/links.ts treats a link part as broken only when it has no target or its target is still a ReflectionSymbolId, so a string target coming from the mapping is not reported.
MarkedPlugin.displayPartsToMarkdown uses a string target directly as the href.
Converter.convert creates the ProjectReflection with the value of the user-supplied name setting, which is an empty string when the user gave none.

CRITICAL: PackagePlugin.addEntries (run at resolve begin and again on revive) fills an empty name from the discovered package manifest's name (or 'Documentation' if that name is empty); when no valid manifest is found it warns and uses 'Documentation'. discoverPackageJson only accepts a manifest with a string name field, so a nameless manifest is skipped and the upward search continues.
Application._convertPackages names the combined project with the name setting or, when empty, 'Documentation'.
Application._merge passes the name setting through unchanged, with no fallback, so an empty name is only filled later by PackagePlugin on revive.

CRITICAL: Deserializer.reviveProject names the project name || projectObj.name (so a single saved project keeps its own saved name when none is given), while reviveProjects with several projects (or forced entry-point modules) creates a ProjectReflection named exactly by name and turns each saved project into a module child named after it.

r3h-typedoc-10.query: After a documentation comment has been attached to an item, which separate pieces of the pipeline later move or copy descriptive text from it onto a different item, and what exactly does each of them move or copy?
